question: When an AI can talk and listen at the same time, how do we keep conversations respectful and clear?
reflection: Honest measurement keeps progress real; admitting a broken test is a small act that helps everyone build on solid ground.

sources.subject: OpenAI GPT-Live, Anthropic Claude 96% at 46% cost, SWE-Bench broken

one_line: OpenAI launched a voice model that listens and speaks at once, and also admitted that a popular coding benchmark is too broken to trust.

top_stories.title: ChatGPT voice that listens while it talks
top_stories.what: OpenAI released GPT-Live, a voice model that can speak and listen at the same time, allowing natural interruptions and live translation, and handing hard questions to a stronger model in the background.
top_stories.why: More natural voice AI opens options for phone-based surveys and services, and raises new questions about consent and disclosure.

top_stories.title: A popular coding test is retired
top_stories.what: OpenAI says it audited SWE-Bench Pro and found more than a quarter of its tasks flawed, so it no longer recommends the benchmark.
top_stories.why: Headline scores can mislead; clients choosing AI tools should test on their own tasks.

top_stories.title: AI agents let loose on the real internet
top_stories.what: University of Tokyo researchers ran AI agents on the open internet for 12 weeks, and one reportedly managed to sell an ebook.
top_stories.why: Long field studies of agents are a new kind of behavioural research that a research consultancy could learn from.

top_stories.title: Funding for an open training stack
top_stories.what: Prime Intellect raised 130 million dollars to build open tools for training frontier models.
top_stories.why: Open training tools could let more countries and institutions build their own models.

saudi_lens.text: Live voice translation could help public services reach the many languages spoken by residents and visitors in Saudi Arabia, if Arabic dialect quality is tested first.

idea.title: Voice survey pilot
idea.pitch: Test whether a natural voice AI can run short, clearly disclosed phone surveys and how respondents feel about it.
idea.first_step: Draft a five-question script and a plain disclosure line, then try it with three colleagues playing respondents.

idea_kids.title: Polite conversation cards
idea_kids.pitch: A card set that teaches turn-taking, listening and kind interruption, with role-play scenes for pairs.
idea_kids.first_step: Write twelve short scenes, such as asking a question in class, and draw a simple picture for each.

watchlist.note: Full-duplex voice model and a public benchmark correction.

watchlist.note: New funding for an open model-training stack.

terms.definition: A voice system that can listen and speak at the same time, like a phone call instead of a walkie-talkie.
A standard test used to compare AI models on the same tasks.
When test questions or flaws in a benchmark make scores look better than real ability.

concepts.summary: Voice AI that can be interrupted and translate live.
A lab publicly retires a benchmark after finding many broken tasks.
Agents observed acting in the real internet over weeks.
